description: This file defines the main React component 'App' for a to-do list application. It manages user authentication state, simple view routing between login, signup, and task pages, and renders corresponding components. It also handles session persistence via local storage and includes logout functionality.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Root React functional component managing the application's main state and view navigation.

methods.description: Handles user logout by clearing session and redirecting to login view.
